title: Open the Year with a Requirement-Matrix Snapshot
teaser: New-year progress must preserve the evidence behind every status.
full_text: Regenerate the matrix from main and verify all 1
theme_tag: 442 unique RC identities are produced under the same provenance rules.

title: Do Not Confuse Sparse Overrides with the Full Matrix
teaser: An empty override ledger does not mean requirement coverage disappeared.
full_text: Validate the sparse requirement-state source together with the generated matrix and confirm only explicit overrides live in the source ledger.

title: Hash the Golden Fixture Source
teaser: Regression comparisons lose meaning if their dataset can drift silently.
full_text: Produce checksums for the approved calculation fixtures and verify any hash change makes the golden gate fail visibly.

title: Record Timezone Dataset Version in Results
teaser: The same wall time can resolve differently after tzdb updates.
full_text: Persist timezone resolver version in the calculation manifest and verify provenance changes when the dataset version changes.

title: Keep Unknown Birth Time as an Explicit State
teaser: Missing time must never become an invented noon value.
full_text: Run a profile with unknown birth time and verify house and angle outputs that require time return an unsupported state.

title: Persist the Selected House System
teaser: A calculation preference must survive reopening the profile.
full_text: Switch between Placidus and Whole Sign then reopen the profile and verify the selected stable ID remains in the calculation manifest.

title: Decouple Orb Presets from Localized Labels
teaser: Changing UI language must not alter technical settings.
full_text: Select the same orb preset under Turkish and English and verify stable IDs plus numeric values remain identical.

title: Test Aspect-Grid Symmetry
teaser: An A-to-B aspect should not disagree with the B-to-A cell.
full_text: Generate a multi-planet grid and verify the empty diagonal plus mirrored aspect identities are symmetric.

title: Validate the Night Segment of Planetary Hours
teaser: Night hours must divide the interval from sunset to the next sunrise correctly.
full_text: Use known solar events and verify the night interval splits into twelve equal segments with the expected ruler sequence.

title: Expose Polar-Day State Explicitly
teaser: Locations without a normal sunset cannot receive fabricated planetary hours.
full_text: Calculate a high-latitude summer fixture and verify the feature returns the documented polar-day unsupported state.

title: Normalize Pythagorean Letter Input Consistently
teaser: Name calculations should not vary with letter casing.
full_text: Calculate one name in several case forms and verify normalization produces the same stable mapping and expression result.

title: Keep Chaldean Mapping Distinct from Pythagorean
teaser: Two numerology systems must not accidentally share one table.
full_text: Calculate the same name in both systems and verify mapping IDs plus provenance remain distinct.

title: Count Missing Lo Shu Values Exactly
teaser: Zero-frequency grid values must not disappear from serialization.
full_text: Process a birth date with repeated and absent digits and verify all cells from one through nine retain exact counts.

title: Test BaZi at a Solar-Term Boundary
teaser: Month pillars must not follow Gregorian month numbers alone.
full_text: Calculate instants immediately around a Jieqi boundary and verify the month pillar changes according to the solar-term rule.

title: Persist Hidden-Stem Order with Stable IDs
teaser: Translation text must not determine stem priority.
full_text: Serialize a branch with multiple hidden stems and verify stable stem-ID order survives locale changes.

title: Bind Tarot Provenance to the Runtime Manifest
teaser: A card image without redistribution evidence cannot qualify for release.
full_text: Verify source license path and checksum for a tarot asset and fail the asset gate when provenance is missing.

title: Write Journal Entries in an Offline Transaction
teaser: Personal journaling should not depend on network connectivity.
full_text: Create a journal entry in airplane mode restart the app and verify body timestamp and UUID remain intact in local storage.

title: Compute Habit Streaks on the Profile Day Boundary
teaser: A streak should not break merely because UTC crossed midnight.
full_text: Record completions near local day end and verify streak logic uses the profile timezone boundary.

title: Protect Consultation History from Client Deletion
teaser: A wrong cascade rule must not erase professional history.
full_text: Apply the client deletion policy with linked consultations and notes and verify archive or restrict behavior matches the schema contract.

title: Lock Restore Preview Counts Before Replace
teaser: Users should know the scope of replacement before committing it.
full_text: Preview a multi-table backup and verify insert update and delete counts are deterministic before the transaction begins.

title: Clean Temporary Files After Restore Failure
teaser: A rejected import must not leave extraction debris behind.
full_text: Start restore with a corrupted archive and verify rollback removes temporary extraction storage completely.

title: Make PDF Font Fallback Deliberate
teaser: Missing glyphs must not silently become empty squares.
full_text: Generate a report containing Turkish text and astrology symbols and verify the selected fonts cover every required glyph.

title: Recompute PDF Page Numbers After Section Selection
teaser: Hidden report sections must not leave numbering gaps.
full_text: Disable several sections and verify preview page numbers exactly match the exported document.

title: Map CSV Import Headers with Stable IDs
teaser: Localized column labels must not define the data contract.
full_text: Import one canonical CSV under Turkish and English UI and verify both parse into the same domain model.

title: Persist PIN Retry State Across Process Restart
teaser: Closing the app must not reset brute-force protection.
full_text: Trigger repeated invalid PIN attempts restart the process and verify lockout state survives in protected persistence.

title: Treat Biometric Cancel Differently from Failure
teaser: A user cancellation should not count as an authentication attack.
full_text: Run cancel and failed-authentication fixtures separately and verify retry policy distinguishes the two outcomes.

title: Measure Minimum Touch Targets Across Main Navigation
teaser: Small icons must not violate accessibility constraints.
full_text: Inspect semantic bounds for Today Tools Records and Profile actions and fail the gate for any target below the minimum size.

title: Test High Dynamic Text Scale for Overflow
teaser: Users with large text settings must retain every action.
full_text: Render primary cards and settings rows at a high text scale and verify no clipping overlap or inaccessible controls appear.

title: Benchmark Cold Start in Release Profile
teaser: Debug timing is not valid release-performance evidence.
full_text: Measure a clean-state release cold start and compare time-to-first-usable-screen against the documented budget.

title: Refresh Date-Bound Caches After Resume
teaser: Daily data must not remain stale after the app crosses a day boundary in background.
full_text: Simulate a background interval across midnight and verify DailySnapshot cache refreshes when the app resumes.

title: Close January from Committed Main Evidence
teaser: February should start only after January is contiguous on main.
full_text: Reload both January locale shards from main verify thirty-one exact dates per locale and record February 1 2036 as the next editorial boundary.
